enhanced.label: Remove background noise
enhanced.help: Keeps your voice and takes out the rest - typing, a fan, a dog, somebody talking behind you. Costs a little battery.

standard.label: Standard
standard.help: The browser's own echo and noise handling. Enough for a quiet room.

off.label: Off
off.help: Send exactly what the microphone hears.

blur.label: Blur my background
blur.help: Everything except you goes out of focus. Costs a little battery.

strong.label: Blur it heavily
strong.help: The same, blurred until nothing behind you can be read.

image.label: Use a picture
image.help: Replaces the room with an image of yours. It stays on this machine.

off.label: Off
off.help: Send the room as the camera sees it.

open.label: Always on
open.note: Your microphone is live until you mute it. What Polaris does unless you say otherwise.

activity.label: Voice activity
activity.note: Your microphone opens when you speak and closes when you stop.

ptt.label: Push to talk
ptt.note: Your microphone is closed except while you hold a key.
